text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm Win Variation. I look forward to your 
guidance!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a protagonist just like Dad. 
—In this world of racing!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me is overflowing with 
talent... But... I'll work harder than 
anyone else and surpass them all for sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
